Universality follows analytically, not from extrapolating those tests.

value.rationale: The orientation of a harmonic trap relative to anisotropic four-axis propulsion is a physical control variable. The theorem solves its stationary dissipation ordering globally, including an exact inversion of the optimal alignment across a natural geometric-mean threshold and a nontrivial flat manifold at which simultaneous anisotropies cancel. These are structural classifications and not a mere restatement of the isotropic 1D formula. The prediction is ideal-population and convention-specific, with no claim of empirical estimation guarantees.
